prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original enemy bestiary illustration and production creature design for an industrial fantasy action RPG. Subject M04 Nail-Belly Parasite: a SMALL compact comma-shaped underground parasite with exactly SIX slender articulated legs, a curled raised abdomen ending in a fan of three long salvaged iron nails which unfolds before it leaps to sting. Its silhouette should read like an unusual compact mineral insect, emphatically not a humanoid robot, spider, scorpion or crab. A squat chitin forebody with small grinding mouthparts supports a soft segmented abdomen curved upward; dark copper-brown chitin has bonded naturally around embedded ochre-rusted nails and fragments of mining hardware. One partly opened seam of old mineral carapace around the upper abdomen suggests it hatches from a parasitic shell; do not add a second separate shell. Six fine hook-tipped legs splay in a poised jumping stance; ALL six legs and nail tips visibly framed. Tiny restrained amber organic gleam at the abdomen seam, no large glowing eyes. Richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy rendering, premium beautiful deliberate shape design, tactile chitin and oxidized metal, charcoal, rust and muted ochre palette with small warm highlights, soft volumetric painterly light and readable dark masses. Original abandoned mining and underground mineral-biological ecology. Three-quarter full-body view of ONE creature isolated on genuinely transparent alpha, generous empty margin on every side, clean cutout edge, no floor, cast shadow, pedestal, environment, smoke, aura or decorative backdrop. No text, symbols, logos, numbers, UI, watermark or existing franchise likeness. Keep this creature petite and finely articulated rather than bulky.
visual_language: Original industrial fantasy: abandoned mining mechanisms fused with mineral-organic growth; rust, charcoal, scratched ochre enamel, restrained amber cores.

alpha_validation.notes: Source PNG alpha preserved without external editing. Alpha-zero RGB may appear colored in previews which ignore alpha; use alpha-aware rendering.

A focused imagegen edit corrected blunt nail heads to sharp outward tips.
production_status: Original transparent concept illustration ready for bestiary/presentation integration. Gameplay directional animation sheets and attack/recovery poses remain separate deliverables.

accepted_edit.prompt: Precise small edit of supplied original industrial-fantasy parasite. Keep its entire design, pose, proportions, lighting, body, six slender legs, chitin, color palette, texture and transparent background exactly as they are. Change ONLY the three iron nails emerging from its raised abdomen: their OUTER ENDS must be sharp long tapered iron points, suitable for a stabbing attack. Currently the visible outer ends are flat round nail heads; replace those flat heads with sharp pointed tips while retaining the three shaft positions and lengths. Keep all other creature details unchanged. Genuine transparent alpha. No added scenery, text, markings or object.
accepted_edit.purpose: Replace outward flat nail heads with outward pointed stabbing tips while preserving the creature.
